_intro: Round 4 re-renders only the types your round 3 ratings asked to change: a set note, or two or more fixes. The same seed as round 3 gives the same room shells, so each picture is the round 3 room redone, shown beside its round 3 strip. Of the bridges only the three with cobblestone roads (BR-01, BR-06, BR-11) are shown again, with their round 3 labels.

One cause sat under three notes: the generator read a floor tile as half a tile away from where the editor draws it, so the row of floor along every north-east wall drew no border. The great halls' brick bands, RM-GREATHALL-01's carpet and RM-KITCHEN-05's hearth all lost their edge there. It is fixed for every room.

The other causes: tavern carpets were blended because a late floor pass took a carpet for a second floor and overrode its trim; every shrine took the first altar of one list (the holy thing now rotates over a map's shrines, as the chapels' altars did in round 3); and the cobblestone at the bridges' ends was measured by the generator's own count rather than where the game draws the planks and the tiles.

Not done in this round: RM-KITCHEN-05 and RM-SHOP-03 were single notes, so they went into those rooms' rules and are not shown again (the kitchen's hearth border is fixed by the north-east wall fix, but its centring and the shop's size and rows are rules only so far). The exterior scenes' single notes (EX-SHRINE-01, EX-GRAVEYARD-04, EX-BANDITCAMP-02) were fixed in their rules and the kit but not re-rendered. No docks.
tavern: Every carpet now ends at a solid trim, as 02's does (01, 03 and 04 had been blended into the boards); 05's rugs are as before. The brick behind each bar has a stone border across the barkeep's opening, where the edge shows.
throne_room: Each throne room now has its own plan: 01 is your round 3 room unchanged; 02 a colonnade with a broad carpet, cathedral columns and candelabras; 03 an audience hall of benches facing the throne; 04 a garden court with two orb pools and plants; 05 the throne standing out, ringed by lights, with a square of obelisks.
great_hall: The brick border round each hall now has its edge all the way round, the north-east wall included, and every carpet its whole trim (01's north-east side was missing). The cause was a half-tile error in where wall seams lie, fixed for every room.
hall: 01 and 03 now follow the plan of 02 and 04: one straight colonnade each side of the aisle (column, statue, column, brazier) and benches along the walls, with no extra rows of statues and urns; 02, 04 and 05 are unchanged.
crypt: The pair of crates is gone from every crypt (crates are no longer allowed in crypts at all); urns, rubble and broken coffins fill those spots. The dark crypt is unchanged.
shrine: No two shrines share an altar now: stone altar, sacred fire, holy font, the Land of the Dead's ark, a burning heap of skulls (other shrines can get the saint's or the wolf's statue, a tomb, the scales or a bier). The obelisks, basins and tapestries stay as they were.
smithy: The 80-99 tile smithies (01, 04) are about a sixth emptier: no barrels mid-floor beyond the stacks in the middle, more racks and armour stands on the walls instead, and a work table with stools in 01. 02, 03 and 05 are unchanged.
barracks: Foot chests now have their back to the bed and their front facing away, for beds against any wall, and stand right at the foot. Where the beds stand in pairs, a chest fills each gap between the pairs.
bridge: Only the three cobblestone-road bridges are shown again: on both banks the cobble now ends exactly at the end of the bridge, the same way at each end. The generator had placed them by its own count rather than where the game draws the planks and the tiles.
